title: InteractionList Overview Tour
description: Browse and manage all interaction records across the organization. Central hub for viewing meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with comprehensive search and filtering capabilities.

popover.title: Welcome to InteractionListComponent
popover.description: This page serves as the central hub for managing all interaction records within the organization. It provides a comprehensive view of meetings, calls, emails, and other communications with partners and contacts. Users can efficiently search, filter, create, edit, and delete interaction entries, ensuring a complete history of engagements.

popover.title: New Interaction
popover.description:
Opens a modal window to create and record a new interaction, such as a meeting, call, email, or general note, with a partner or contact.

When to use: When you have completed a new communication (e.g., a phone call, email exchange) and need to log it., When you are scheduling or have just finished a meeting and want to record its details.

popover.title: Import Interactions
popover.description:
Initiates the process to bulk import multiple interaction records from an external file, typically a Google Sheet or CSV.

When to use: When you need to migrate a large volume of historical interaction data from another system., When you receive interaction data from a third party in a structured file format.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of InteractionList. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
